summary: This bill requires that any new "major rule" proposed by a federal agency cannot take effect until Congress passes a joint resolution approving it, and it establishes expedited procedures for Congress to consider such resolutions.

scores.thoughts: The bill requires the Comptroller General to conduct a study on the economic cost of existing rules and major rules. This study would incur some government spending, but it is a minor, one-time cost compared to the overall scope of government spending, and not the primary focus of the bill.
